title: Building a Powerful Business Case
overview: In this course, you will discover how to leverage all available resources to define the parameters of a business case and create a compelling presentation to effectively convey your message. By broadening your range of analytical tools, this course empowers you to craft a credible, evidence-based business case presented through PowerPoint. Beyond business case development, the course equips you with the proficiency to enhance your presentation delivery, irrespective of the subject, audience, or medium.

"Building and Presenting a Powerful Business Case" is an interactive course, offering a business case toolkit and opportunities for hands-on practice in presentation delivery, with valuable constructive feedback
audience: This hands-on course is designed for individuals seeking a noticeable improvement in their business case development and presentation skills. It is especially beneficial for those who regularly prepare and deliver presentations to senior management. The workshop-style format ensures practical, applicable learning experiences
methodology: This course employs a diverse range of interactive techniques, including analytical tools, case studies, presentation development, presentation delivery, and individual feedback
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Identify and apply the key steps in business case development
Break down and analyze requirements systematically
Utilize a comprehensive business case toolkit for critical analysis
Structure and deliver a compelling business case
Prepare for presentations using a systematic approach
Incorporate visually appealing and commonly available visual aids in presentations

items.text: Utilizing a hypothesis-driven approach in 6 steps
Formulating problem statements and the critical question
Framing a problem using Situation, Complication, Question, and Answer (SCQA)
Adhering to the MECE Principle (Mutually Exclusive, Collectively Exhaustive)
Tools in the business case toolbox
Mastery of the five primary chart types
Formulating and executing a communication plan

outline.title: Preparing for a Business Case Presentation

items.text: Diverse sources of data and presentation content
Determining the appropriate amount of information
